about: The modules Setup > Modules offers. Each entry comes from a module's build (dist/registry-entry.json); see Documentation/Modules.md.

modules.name: Digital Modes (FT8 / FT4 / FT2 / JT65 / JT9 / JT4 / Q65 / FST4 / WSPR / FST4W)
modules.description: FT8, FT4, JT65, JT9, WSPR, and (experimental, not yet tested on the air) FT2, JT4, Q65, FST4 and FST4W inside Kainos: band activity, automatic QSO sequencing and an ADIF log, in the Kainos look. Decoding by WSJT-X's jt9 (included).
modules.author: Justin Cron K7JUS

modules.name: SSTV (slow-scan TV)
modules.description: Slow-scan TV inside Kainos: receive Martin, Scottie, Robot 36 and PD pictures (found automatically, slant-corrected, with the sender's callsign and a gallery), and send them: a one-time station setup makes your CQ, Reply and 73 pictures, and Reply answers in the sender's mode.
modules.author: Justin Cron K7JUS

modules.name: Voice Keyer (DVK)
modules.description: A digital voice keyer: 12 recordings on F1 - F12, recorded from your mic and sent through your whole transmit chain so they sound like you. Preview, repeat CQ with a listening gap, WAV import and export.
modules.author: Justin Cron K7JUS

modules.name: Logbook
modules.description: A logbook in the Kainos look: callsign lookup as you type (country, zones, beam heading, QRZ / HamQTH / callook), worked-before by band and mode, QSOs from VFO A and from the FT8 and SSTV modules, ADIF import and export. Uploads to LoTW (through TQSL), eQSL, QRZ Logbook and Club Log, with confirmations brought back. POTA: activators on the air (click to tune), activations with the files pota.app wants, and spotting yourself. Contests: 37 of them, with the exchange, dupes, mults, the score, Cabrillo, and Enter / F1 - F3 sending CQ, the exchange and TU (CW, or the Voice Keyer on phone; Kainos 1.0.15). Awards: DXCC, WAS, WAZ and grids, worked and confirmed.
modules.author: Justin Cron K7JUS

modules.name: PSK
modules.description: PSK keyboard chat inside Kainos: PSK31 - PSK500, QPSK31 - QPSK500, PSK-R (PSK63F, PSK125R - PSK500R) and 8PSK (8PSK125 - 8PSK500, with or without FEC), compatible with fldigi. Click a signal on the waterfall to read it, or turn on the browser to read every signal in the passband at once; type to send, with F1 - F8 messages, and log the QSO.
modules.author: Justin Cron K7JUS

modules.name: Hellschreiber (Feld Hell)
modules.description: Hellschreiber inside Kainos: Feld Hell, Slow Hell, Hell x5, Hell x9, FSK-Hell 245, FSK-Hell 105 and Hell 80, compatible with fldigi. Click a signal on the waterfall and its text is drawn as it arrives (twice, so one copy is always whole); type to send, with F1 - F8 messages, and log the QSO.
modules.author: Justin Cron K7JUS

modules.name: DominoEX / THOR
modules.description: DominoEX and THOR keyboard chat inside Kainos: every speed from Micro to DominoEX 88 and THOR 100, compatible with fldigi. Incremental frequency keying rides through drift and fading; THOR adds error correction. Click a signal on the waterfall to read it; type to send, with F1 - F8 messages, and log the QSO.
modules.author: Justin Cron K7JUS

modules.name: Olivia / MFSK
modules.description: Olivia, Contestia and MFSK keyboard chat inside Kainos, compatible with fldigi: every Olivia and Contestia tones / bandwidth from 4/125 to 64/2000, and MFSK4 to MFSK128L. Olivia reads signals well below the noise and finds a signal within 4 tones of where you click. Type to send, with F1 - F8 messages, and log the QSO.
modules.author: Justin Cron K7JUS
